scope_definition: Urban textiles, fibres, fibre-forming polymers and precursors; matched resin/film/bulk forms may qualify without textile-use prose.
legacy_counter_aliases: verified_textile_* retained as aliases for all admitted target materials; use the material-class breakdown to distinguish finished textiles and precursors.
counting_rule: One original source/sample/material/treatment/washing state across TG conditions. Admit documentary reviewed textiles,fibres,fibre-forming polymers and precursor materials,including their matched resin/film/bulk tests without textile-use prose. Composite materials containing an eligible fibre-forming polymer are classified separately. Exact formulation/form/state pairing and ordinary scientific gates remain mandatory. Unknown material eligibility remains pending; no keyword-only admission.
admission_basis: Exact manual scope evidence, material/state/documentary hash and reviewed measurement fingerprint. Pending scope contributes zero to the target.
